description: State classification MUST be implemented as a whitelist (REG-021), never a blacklist: a raw driver value the media-player class explicitly recognizes (playing, off) classifies to its own designated state, and a raw value this driver has never seen before (a vendor-specific quirk mode) classifies to the class's own unknown_state_fallback, off (REG-062) — never to a permissive default the classifier merely fails to blacklist away.
